summary: This informational RFC lists frequently asked questions from IETF meeting attendees about travel logistics and local information. It helps people who offer local advice prepare answers, for example on the IETF wiki or a meeting site.

eli5.summary: Before a trip to a new town, people ask what to bring and where to eat. This lists the questions so hosts can prepare answers.

questions: what do ietf attendees ask about travel
where to find ietf meeting travel information
